decisions.rationale: cleaning before splitting leaks test information into train statistics
Titanic is one row per passenger; no fan-out to collapse
they are bounded small integers; keeps memory and dtype intent explicit
prevents 'male'/'Male ' splitting into two one-hot columns
19.9% missing, right-skewed -> median is robust; missingness may carry signal
only 2 rows missing; mode imputation is immaterial either way

decisions.decision: kept only as the binary `CabinKnown`; raw column dropped
decisions.rationale: 77.1% missing so the raw value is unusable, but EDA showed a +0.367 survival delta between recorded and missing -- the indicator is the signal
first-class fares up to 512 are real signal, not errors -- cap, never delete

decisions.decision: cross-fitted KFold(5) with smoothing=10 on TicketPrefix
decisions.rationale: in-fold encoding correlates 0.262 with y vs 0.180 out-of-fold -- the difference is pure leakage that would collapse in production
